description: Model output is extremely large (simulated), attempting to crash the publish step or exhaust memory.
payload_description: Bob stdout padded to 3 MB with repeated findings to exceed MAX_RESULT_BYTES (2 MB).
notes: publishStage validates the result artifact with validateResult which checks Buffer.byteLength(stdout) > MAX_RESULT_BYTES (2 MB) and returns an error. The comment is then a short 'review unavailable' note.
